findings.message: śivāya is flagged epithet: true, but its meaning is only 'to Śiva' and it has no note in this verse saying the name means 'the auspicious one'. The only trace is components[0].sense.gloss (mw-shiva.md: 'The Auspicious one'). The rubric allows a common name when a note explains its meaning once. That note may be in the refrain of an earlier verse (e.g. v1), which this bundle does not show, so a human should confirm it exists.
findings.suggested_fix: If no earlier verse explains it, add a note to words.w11.
